'''South Quia''' is a sub-continent located in the southern hemisphere. It is bordered the [[North Quia|North]], [[West Quia|West]] and [[East Quia]] to the north, the [[Haanian Ocean]] to the southwest, and the [[Southern Eanif Ocean]] to the east. The continent covers around {{convert|13,908,738|km2|sqmi|abbr=on}} of land, making it the largest sub-continent in the world, with a total of about 74,200,007 as of 1765, making it also the 22nd largest sub-continent by population.
